exp.2.title: Senior Project: The system for testing the temperature and electric current standards of an iron.

exp.2.bullets.1: Developed a custom gateway application with Electron.js, enabling communication between the computer and the microcontroller via Serial protocol for command transmission and data collection.
exp.2.bullets.2: Stored temperature data in a PostgreSQL database, ensuring reliable and structured data management.
exp.2.bullets.3: Created a dashboard using Next.js, visualizing temperature trends and device status for effective monitoring and control.
